create_fallback: create or update fallback models for a specific model in the LiteLLM proxy router settings
get_fallback: get fallback models configured for a specific model in the LiteLLM proxy
delete_fallback: delete fallback configuration for a specific model from the LiteLLM proxy router settings
create_fallback_with_type: create a fallback with a specific type (general, context_window, or content_policy) for a model
get_fallback_with_type: get fallback models of a specific type (general, context_window, or content_policy) for a model
